reference.name: Malan1985
reference.title: Chronopharmacokinetics of paracetamol in normal subjects.
reference.abstract: The chronopharmacokinetics of paracetamol was studied in six male volunteers. Serum concentrations of paracetamol were determined after a single oral dose of 1 g, on three occasions, spaced at least 1 week apart. Plasma drug concentration vs time curves were obtained after dosage at 08.00 h (Day 1), 14.00 h (Day 2) and 20.00 h (Day 3), under standardized conditions. Pharmacokinetic parameters compared were t1/2,alpha, t1/2,Z, tmax, Cmax and AUCpo. No statistically significant differences were found.

descriptions.text: The chronopharmacokinetics of paracetamol was studied in six male volunteers. Serum concentrations of paracetamol were determined after a single oral dose of 1 g, on three occasions, spaced at least 1 week apart. Plasma drug concentration vs time curves were obtained after dosage at 08.00 h (Day 1), 14.00 h (Day 2) and 20.00 h (Day 3), under standardized conditions. Pharmacokinetic parameters compared were t1/2_a, t1/2_z tmax Cmax and AUCpo. No statistically significant differences were found.
Six healthy non-smoking adult male volunteers participated in the study. An open cross-over trial design was used, i.e. each volunteer served as his own control.
No other medication was permitted for the duration of the project.

comments.text: A standardized meal was ingested 2 h after medication.
On the first trial day, medication was taken at 08.00 h, on the second at 14.00 h and on the third, at 20.00 h.

descriptions.text: Blood samples were drawn via an indwelling intravenous cannula, before and at the following intervals after medication: 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 6 and 8 h.
